summary.text: Paul Anderson is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has served in the House since 2009, currently representing District 12A, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer who owns Anderson Farms, he is co-chair of the House Agriculture Finance and Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Anderson earned a B.A. from the University of Minnesota at Morris in 1974.
His career experience includes owning Anderson Farms and working as a farmer.
Anderson has served in the Minnesota House of Representatives since 2009 and has represented District 12A since January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy Committee, which he co-chaired, and to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy and State Government Finance and Policy committees.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
